alex: FYI i ran `yarn typegen:regen` on main and got a tiny header change in the generated typeset that ended up marking Authorization as sensitive
mira: oof, does that affect anything runtime?
alex: yes — node sdk uses header sensitivity to form retry keysets, so sensitive headers were excluded from retry identity and some auth retries were incorrectly deduped
ops: saw retries spike in staging yesterday, thought it was network noise. this could be the cause
ci-bot: CI job package-publish failed: version tag mismatch. logs: https://ci.example/rdw/2026/1769500000
mira: is the regenerator PR missing a changelog/semver bump? i remember a recent regen without version changes
alex: yeah i merged a small regen commit and forgot the semver bump — publish script aborted with "Version mismatch: package.json != tag"
mira: two problems then: (1) auth header sensitivity change causing retry behavior regression, (2) publish blocked by missing semver bump
alex: plan: revert the sensitivity tweak in typegen mapping, cut a patch (1.5.1), and put a CI guard so typegen diffs without changelog/semver fail the PR
ops: also recommend that examples/onboard smoke tests use the built local package in CI so we catch regressions before npm tagging
mira: agree. i'll open revert PR and add a short changelog note: "fix(sdk): treat Authorization as non-sensitive for retry key derivation; revert accidental sensitivity change"
ci-bot: New PR created: #4250 revert: header sensitivity mapping
devex-bot: Added task DEVEX-799: typegen diff guard + staged-publish smoke gate + publish retry wrapper
ops: in the meantime we can hotfix staging by pinning sdk to previous tag
alex: i'll run the onboarding sample locally against the revert branch to validate retry keys. command: cd examples/onboarding && yarn && node ./dist/smoke.js
mira: adding a lint step in openapi->typegen so header sensitivity flips require explicit semver guidance sounds good
ci-bot: after PR #4250 queued: typegen check passed on CI, tests running
ops: when we publish patch, add retries around npm publish (3 attempts) and a short backoff
alex: merged revert and published 1.5.1. samples smoke clean locally. will post a short note in #general and ping support
mira: thanks for quick turnaround. follow-ups: implement DEVEX-799 and add examples CI to validate local artifacts before tagging
ops: closing loop: monitoring shows retry error rate back to baseline :thumbsup:
